messages:
priya: Heads-up — nightly bench pipeline failed for model-refresh: kv-cache fsync errors on shard-7, causing the job to abort. Started 03:20 UTC.
priya: error snippet from runner logs:```ERROR kv_cache: fsync failed: IOError: [Errno 5] Input/output error
  at /srv/bench/runner/cache.py:214
  shard=7 model=redwood-tiny-quant```
mike: ouch. did the runner node have disk pressure or a pod restart?
priya: disk pressure alert fired on the node around the same time; kube reported OOMKilled for a sidecar (metrics-collector).
priya: job rerun is currently failing fast because the checkpoint appears partially written for shard-7.
alana: @infra-ops can you check disk health on node-ml-42? sounds like hardware/nfs flakiness.
infra-ops: looking now — node-ml-42 shows I/O errors on /dev/nvme1n1, SMART reports increased reallocated sectors. pulling logs and will patch-taint.
jordan: if node is flaky we should avoid automatic rerun on the same node. Can we pin the cron to different pool?
priya: good call. current cron uses pool=bench-default which still includes node-ml-42.
mike: quick mitigation: pause nightly until infra replaces node OR add a nodeSelector for bench-stable-pool and trigger a manual rerun.
priya: I can trigger manual rerun to bench-stable once infra taints node-ml-42.
infra-ops: tainted node-ml-42:+no-bench at 03:50 UTC. moving to maintenance.
sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-072 — nightly-bench-kvcache-ioerrors. Assigned: infra-ops.
jordan: thanks. @priya please attach the failing log snippet to the incident (helps postmortem).
priya: attached logs and linked the failing job: https://ci.redwood.dev/job/bench-refresh/2026-03-10-03:20
priya: Question for the team: should we 1) rerun immediately on bench-stable, 2) bisect to see when shard-7 started degrading, or 3) skip this run and let next scheduled attempt run?
mike: I'd vote 1 then 2. rerun will tell us if checkpoint corrupted only on that node or broader. bisect if rerun still fails.
alana: agreed. 1 then 2. I'll help with bisect if needed.
priya: OK I'll kick the rerun to bench-stable at 04:05 UTC and monitor. tagging @jordan for approval if any rollout impact.
jordan: approved. please set a short TTL for resource allocation (2h) so we don't hold capacity.
priya: running manual rerun now: `./ci trigger bench-refresh --pool bench-stable --shard 0..11 --priority high`
priya: initial logs show shard-7 now reading from s3 checkpoint successfully, no fsync errors so far.
mike: nice. keep an eye on throughput — if we see high tail latency it might be KV cache missstorm after the corrupted checkpoint replacement.
priya: noted. monitoring dashboards pinned to thread.
priya: if rerun completes cleanly I'll close INC-2026-072 and add a postmortem with remediation (replace nvme, add node health probe).
infra-ops: NVMe replacement scheduled for 2026-03-11 09:00 UTC.
priya: thanks. closing loop in ~2h if all green. :thumbsup:
